name: Nippon Electric Glass Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Electric Glass Co., Ltd. makes and sells high-performance glass products and glassmaking machinery globally, with operations in Japan, China, South Korea, the United States and Europe. Its products include substrates of glass for flat panel displays, glass fibers, thin-film coatings and glass strengthened chemically, as well as glass for pharmaceutical, medical and construction uses. Dating from 1944, it has its headquarters in Otsu, Japan.
